base_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent bitmap plant canopy for a professional landscape garden plan.
Create exactly one individual plant asset, canopy viewed strictly from directly overhead, ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP DOWN. Detailed decorative polished botanical-inspired illustrative garden-plan rendering, rich fine stippled individual leaves or needles and flowers. Softly layered foliage, crisp natural irregular edges, natural color variation and highlights, subtle internal shadows. Consistent restrained high-quality landscape-plan illustration style, not a photograph, not flat vector, not an icon, not a simple circle, not watercolor wash.
Composition: one plant centered in a square image of at least 1024 by 1024 pixels. Whole canopy inside 90% of image with small fully transparent margin. Preserve naturally varied width and height and irregular outline. Actual transparent background, including gaps between leaves.
Constraints: no side view, no perspective, no horizon, no exposed side-view trunk, no soil, no pot, no ground disk, no labels, no frame, no text, no watermark, no cast shadow far outside canopy.
extra_prompt_from_index_5: Keep all leaf tips visibly away from canvas edge, with a clear transparent margin on all four sides.
